note: 'percentile' is where this move sits among all moves we have measured for runners opening at a similar price. The median move is near zero in every band; what changes with price is the spread of outcomes.

reissued.reason: Reissued on 6 October 2026. A faulty country filter had let runners at meetings outside the UK and Ireland, mostly German and Saudi, into this archive. Any that ran on this day have been removed, and every percentile has been recomputed against a baseline without them.
